title: A One-Sided McDiarmid-Type Inequality for Heavy Tails via Reverse KL Tensorization
abstract: arXiv:2610.21103v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We revisit McDiarmid's inequality, a central tool in statistical learning theory and algorithm analysis. We show that large deviations above the mean are exponentially unlikely for functions of independent random variables that are almost surely bounded above and satisfy a conditional moment assumption of order $p\in(1,2]$. When $p<2$, the result applies even when the function has infinite variance. Our proof relies on a new tensorization inequality for the Kullback--Leibler divergence, termed reverse KL tensorization, which may be of independent interest. Applications include concentration of the sample mean and median-of-means estimator, and one-sided uniform risk bounds for unbounded losses.

translated_title: 基于反向KL张量化的重尾单边McDiarmid型不等式
translated_abstract: 我们重新审视了McDiarmid不等式，它是统计学习理论和算法分析中的一个核心工具。我们证明，对于几乎必然有上界且满足阶数为 $p\in(1,2]$ 的条件矩假设的独立随机变量的函数，偏离均值上方的大偏差呈指数级不可能。当 $p<2$ 时，即使函数具有无限方差，该结果依然适用。我们的证明依赖于Kullback–Leibler散度的一个新的张量化不等式，称为反向KL张量化，这一结果可能具有独立的研究价值。应用包括样本均值和中位数均值估计量的集中性，以及无界损失的单边一致风险界。
tldr: 本文提出了一种新的反向KL张量化不等式，证明了对几乎必然有上界且仅满足 $p\in(1,2]$ 阶条件矩的独立随机变量函数，均值上方的大偏差呈指数级不可能，即使方差无限也成立，并应用于无界损失的单边一致风险界。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a new reverse KL tensorization inequality, showing that large upward deviations from the mean are exponentially unlikely for functions of independent random variables that are almost surely bounded above and satisfy a conditional moment assumption of order $p\in(1,2]$—even with infinite variance—with applications to one-sided uniform risk bounds for unbounded losses.
